text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
We've been on a losing streak lately, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What? No, no!
There's nothing for you to apologize for, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, the real race starts NOW!
Let's pass everyone and become number ONE!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "That's why you and I, Trainer, need to be like a three-legged race!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well~...
I think in Japanese, it's 'three legs'...
choice_data_list: Let's work hard together, step by step.
Let's retrain together, hand in hand.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
Three-legged race to victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
With you and me as a team, Trainer,
let's deliver happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!
Spartan training, bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"To deliver happiness to everyone,
and to become number one from here on out—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
With you and me as a team, Trainer,
let's become stronger and stronger!!
